maddeler.e:
ائتلت (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلْتُ (iʔtaltu) /iʔ.tal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# اِئْتَلْتَ (iʔtalta) /iʔ.tal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# اِئْتَلْتِ (iʔtalti) /iʔ.tal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
